description: This Java source file defines the ClientCollateralManagement entity class which models collateral management data associated with clients in the Apache Fineract project. The class includes fields for quantity, references to Client and CollateralManagementDomain entities, and methods for creating, updating, and calculating collateral values.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagement
classes.description: Entity class representing collateral management details of a client, including quantity, associated client, collateral, and related loan collateral management sets.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ClientCollateralManagement from a JsonCommand input, setting the quantity based on the JSON parameters.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ClientCollateralManagement with specified quantity, client, and collateral.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity if there is a change indicated in the JsonCommand, returning the changes made.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total value of the collateral for this client based on quantity and base price.

methods.name: getTotalCollateral
methods.description: Calculates collateral value based on a total and the percentage to base price.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity field with a new value.

methods.name: updateQuantityAfterLoanClosed
methods.description: Adjusts the quantity after a loan is closed by adding the specified amount.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the current quantity of collateral.

methods.name: getCollaterals
methods.description: Returns the collateral management details object.
